segments.motivation: To efficiently organize, track, and visualize project progress and team assignments.
To manage personal and team tasks, improve workflow visibility, and facilitate collaboration.
To oversee various operational tasks, client projects, or content pipelines with a simple, visual tool.

tasks.purpose: to clearly see progress and priorities
to clarify ownership and workload distribution
to streamline communication and feedback loops
to visualize and optimize operational processes

benefits.claim: Provides a clear, visual overview of all tasks and project statuses at a glance.
The drag-and-drop interface makes it intuitive and simple to manage tasks and projects.
Facilitates seamless team collaboration and communication around shared work items.

frictions.claim: Can become unwieldy for very large or complex projects with numerous dependencies.
Lacks advanced reporting or analytics features for in-depth project tracking and insights.
May require additional 'power-ups' or integrations for advanced functionalities like time tracking or Gantt charts.
